programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: The celebration of Cantonese cooking begins in one of Melbourne’s most iconic restaurants, Flower Drum, in the heart of Chinatown. MasterChef alumni and friend, Karlie Verkerk, shares her recipe Yum Cha favourite dessert, ‘Mango Pudding’. For the main course, Diana creates ‘Pak Cham Kai’ by poaching a whole chicken in a pot with aromatics and topping with infused oil – Cantonese home cooking, simple yet delicious.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Singaporean cuisine is widely influenced by several ethnic groups that make up the population. MasterChef winner Sashi Cheliah, raised in Singapore, shares his ‘Quick & easy Briyani’ which has a distinct Indian flair. Next is the famous ‘Fish Head Curry’, which has mixed Indian and Chinese influences. Finaly, Diana cooks one of her favourite ‘Hokkien Mee’, a simple noodle dish created using a homemade prawn stock.

programme.desc: One home cook attempts to make a crowd-pleasing dish that’s nutritious and delicious, and the Wall of Chefs kitchen explodes with culture in the Chef’s Fridge round, which features staple ingredients from famed Japanese/Italian Chef Joël Watanabe.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Host Sarah Sharratt is invited by her local mayor to accompany him on a seasonal pigeon hunt; a tradition that dates back hundreds of years in the region. The hunters inpire Sarah to throw a dinner party featuring stuffed pigeon on roasted fennel and pommes dauphinoise (potato gratin). For dessert Sarah makes an apple tresse with armagnac, another traditional ingredient she sources from a famous local producer.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Something as simple as a family picnic has an elegance in France. Host Sarah Sharratt's picnic menu consists of egg and cheese filo tarts, spaghetti frittata and strawberry cobblers cooked in little jam jars. Sarah visits a goat cheese maker in the famous cliffside village of Rocamadour, and helps with a strawberry harvest in a local greenhouse. The entire family, unruly dogs included, head off for the picnic where Sarah tries to convince everyone that a baby goat should be in their future.
